display: Akrura on his journey to Vraja
scope: D072 chapter-specific provisional narrative contract; not an approved character sheet.

depiction_rules.notes: Akrura is Krishna’s long-standing devotee, traveling under Kamsa’s command. He is never a villain or reluctant antagonist; show reverence, joy, humility and inward devotion.

visual_bible.age: mature adult man; exact age unspecified
visual_bible.face: distinct clearly adult masculine face with thoughtful devotional expression; mature facial structure, short dark hair or simply tied dark hair, with an optional small neat moustache to keep him visibly male; no feminine features or high hair bun.
visual_bible.skin: warm brown mineral pigment, clearly brown rather than saturated orange
visual_bible.hair: short dark hair or simply tied dark hair; avoid a high feminine-looking bun.
visual_bible.build: ordinary adult proportions; one face, two attached arms and hands, two legs and feet
visual_bible.clothing: simple cream dhoti and muted olive or maroon shawl; restrained jewelry, no royal costume
visual_bible.continuity_markers: same mature devotee, simple travel clothes, warm-brown skin and humble demeanor across the journey and welcome

never: no villain styling, armor, fangs, distortion, or menacing caricature
no extra or detached limbs, fingers, toes, duplicate people, or fused bodies
no glossy skin, metallic ornament, modern details, or readable text
do not depict Akrura as a woman or feminine-presenting figure
